title: DO LARGE GPT MODELS DISCOVER MORAL DIMENSIONS IN LANGUAGE REPRESENTATIONS? A TOPOLOGICAL STUDY OF SENTENCE EMBEDDINGS.
reasoning: The paper specifically investigates how Large Language Models represent moral dimensions, focusing on the concept of fairness and moral judgments. It develops a fairness metric inspired by social psychology to analyze if models like GPT-3.5 induce an understanding of moral values like legitimacy, need, and responsibility during their training process.
